body_markdown:
VANCOUVER, Wash.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 11, 2026-- ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, today announced that its MCP Server is now listed on the Cursor Marketplace, giving developers and revenue teams a native way to bring ZoomInfo's verified GTM data into Cursor's AI coding agent.


SpaceXAI users install the[integration directly from the Cursor Marketplace](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcursor.com%2Fmarketplace%2Fzoominfo&esheet=54598889&newsitemid=20260911992328&lan=en-US&anchor=integration+directly+from+the+Cursor+Marketplace&index=1&md5=7bcca48a26f93d04492731340b436da0) with a single command, and from that point Cursor agent conversations can call ZoomInfo's verified GTM data as a first-class data source alongside the codebase itself. The connective tissue underneath the integration is[GTM.AI](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fgtm.ai&esheet=54598889&newsitemid=20260911992328&lan=en-US&anchor=GTM.AI&index=2&md5=33655cefc75ef1554823b9f2d5916da4) , ZoomInfo's headless GTM context layer, the same API and Model Context Protocol home that already powers Salesforce Agentforce, HubSpot Breeze, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and many more.


“SpaceXAI is built to help developers move from idea to execution with greater speed and confidence. By bringing ZoomInfo’s verified GTM intelligence directly into the Cursor agent experience, we’re giving technical and revenue teams access to a more seamless way to research accounts, understand buyers, and turn insight into action without leaving the tools where they work,” said Toni Adams, SVP Partnerships, SpaceXAI . “This integration makes business context accessible alongside the codebase, helping teams collaborate more effectively on the products and go-to-market motions they build.”


**How does the ZoomInfo and SpaceXAI integration work?**


The plugin installs from the Cursor Marketplace with the command /add-plugin zoominfo. It ships 14 skills, including account research, list building, buying committee mapping, competitor analysis, and company enrichment, giving Cursor agent conversations the ability to research companies and contacts, analyze buyer intent, and build prospect lists without leaving the editor.


A user can ask Cursor's agent to find companies spiking on a given technology's buyer intent, then request contacts at those accounts. The agent enriches the records and automatically flags any contact marked Do-Not-Call, so outreach defaults to a direct line or email instead of a mobile number.


**What is GTM.AI?**


GTM.AI is ZoomInfo's headless GTM context layer. It provides access to ZoomInfo's verified data graph (100M companies, 500M contacts, and billions of signals), agentic orchestration, and platform-level governance through API and Model Context Protocol, so any agent, platform, or workflow can plug in. Cursor is one of dozens of surfaces where GTM.AI already runs, alongside Salesforce Agentforce, HubSpot Breeze, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Alysio, Claude, and ChatGPT.


**Availability**


The ZoomInfo MCP Server for Cursor is generally available today on the Cursor Marketplace.


**About ZoomInfo**


ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go-to-market strategy with confidence. Powered by the industry's most comprehensive B2B data, including more than 100 million companies, 500 million contacts, and billions of signals, ZoomInfo delivers the intelligence, automation, and integrations that modern revenue teams need to identify, engage, and convert their best buyers.


GTM.AI is ZoomInfo's headless GTM context layer. It is the API and Model Context Protocol home for AI agents, powering integrations across Salesforce Agentforce, HubSpot Breeze, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Alysio, Claude, ChatGPT, and dozens more.
